name: PowOS device agent (Devices app control channel)
purpose: the phone's card, live status (battery, screen on/off, locked) and actions (lock, screen off/on, ring, wake another device by Wake-on-LAN) for the Devices app on the other PowOS devices, so Desk can see and lock the phone; HTTPS :3416 with its own pinned certificate, every status/action call authenticated by a per-device token given at pairing (code shown on this phone) or enrollment; mDNS _powos._tcp. A system-tier service (lib/apps/services/powos-deviced.json). Rooted backend: adb to itself (HACK row in docs/REMOTE-POWOS.md section 4). docs/DEVICES.md
files: /home/powos/.local/state/powos/deviced (identity, TLS key, paired peers as token hashes, enrollment; 0700)
autosleep: never: idle in accept(), a few MB; the phone's own sleep is Android's

keep: /home/powos/.local/state/powos/deviced (delete it to forget every pairing, the enrollment and the device id)
